recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants StructureMap.structure.url or FHIR Mapping Language uses statements to directly accept Questionnaire canonicals as searchable metadata, handle that as a new source-changing decision.
issue_request: FHIR-10428 asked that StructureMap be able to identify constrained inputs and outputs such as profiles and Questionnaires; it was Published as Persuasive with Modification with the resolution that the mapping language already supports this.
initial_application: No FHIR-10428-tagged implementation commit was found. The original draft StructureMap source already had StructureMap.structure.url as a URI for a canonical structure URL, and current refactored source carries this as canonical(StructureDefinition).
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureMap.structure.url and FHIR Mapping Language uses statements target StructureDefinition, which includes profiles. Current mapping rules also provide FHIRPath condition/check expressions that can enforce QuestionnaireResponse-specific prerequisites without changing StructureMap.structure.url. Later Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting final core decision.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was made because adding Questionnaire as a direct StructureMap.structure target would be a new semantic expansion beyond the published resolution.
